notes: «جماعة مشايخي منهم» names its members: the two named men form the first level; the collective phrase is not written as a link.
جميعا marks the three co-transmitters of سعد as one level before الحسن بن علي بن فضال.
The Imam written after «عن» (أبي عبد الله) stays narrator (owner ruling 2); the honorific is left out.
